description: Source file for a Git-like references backend, managing references via filesystem operations, including reading, writing, locking, pruning, and reflog handling.

classes.name: ref_lock
classes.description: Structure representing a lock on a reference, including its name, lock file, previous object id, and usage count.

classes.name: files_ref_store
classes.description: Main structure for managing file-based references, including configuration, cache, and related paths.

classes.name: ref_dir
classes.description: Represents directory structure for references in the filesystem (implied but not explicitly shown).

classes.name: ref_entry
classes.description: Represents individual reference entries within a directory.

classes.name: ref_iterator
classes.description: Iterator abstraction for walking over references, with specific implementation for filesystem back-end.
